facts.statement: Only src/RackCad.Plugin creates AutoCAD objects. No file in RackCad.Application, RackCad.UI or RackCad.Domain references Autodesk.AutoCAD. The one 'new Line(' hit outside the Plugin is an Application-local geometry type, not an AutoCAD entity.
facts.evidence: git grep -l "Autodesk.AutoCAD" 3375aadb -- src/RackCad.UI src/RackCad.Application src/RackCad.Domain -> no files; src/RackCad.Application/StructuralSections/Geometry/SectionProjectionCanonicalizer.cs:320 (imports only System.* and RackCad.Application.Geometry, lines 1-4)

facts.statement: Every header-run kind and view (Selective frontal/planta/lateral, Dynamic frontal/planta/lateral, Push Back frontal/planta/lateral, Cama, Cabecera lateral/planta) writes its geometry through LateralHeaderDrawer. Create path: ViewBlockDraw -> SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock -> LateralHeaderDrawer.CreateSystemBlock. Redefine path: SystemBlockWriter.RedefineInTransaction -> LateralHeaderDrawer.RedefineSystemBlock. Cabecera lateral and the Selective lateral corte go through LateralHeaderDrawService, which calls the same drawer.

LateralHeaderDrawer creates exactly four DatabaseServices types: BlockTableRecord, BlockReference, DBText and RotatedDimension. It also creates LayerTableRecord indirectly through LayerHelper. Its methods create no other entity type.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:243 (new BlockTableRecord in NewBlock), :60, :145, :308 (new BlockReference), :266 (new DBText), :354 (new RotatedDimension), :331, :356 (LayerHelper.EnsureLayer)

facts.statement: A view definition is one named BlockTableRecord. It contains references to each nested header-group definition at its placements (mirrored placements use scale (-1,1,1)) plus all loose instances. Each HeaderGroup becomes its own named nested BlockTableRecord, and its instances are appended into that nested definition. Redefine erases the view definition's contents and repopulates them in place, so the BTR id is kept, then calls RecordGraphicsModified on every reference.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:38-51 (nested def per group, instances appended into headerDef), :54-68 (system def + refs to nested defs, mirror scale :62), :70-76 (loose into system def), :97-118 (erase existing), :130-161 (repopulate), :167-171 (RecordGraphicsModified), :240-247 (NewBlock)

facts.statement: Annotation instances (DBText) and Dimension instances (RotatedDimension) end up only as loose entities in the view definition, never inside a nested header-group definition. Evidence chain: (1) Annotation instances have one factory, SelectiveAnnotations.Label. (2) Dimension instances have two factories, SelectiveDimensions.Dim and DynamicViewDecorations.Dimension. (3) HeaderInstanceGrouper forces both roles loose. (4) Every traced call site adds them to a loose list or to a list that passes through the grouper. (5) The group producers built from cabecera/RackFrames layouts and from PushBackCompositeContent emit no Annotation/Dimension.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Selective/SelectiveAnnotations.cs:23-32; Systems/Selective/SelectiveDimensions.cs:304-314; Systems/Dynamic/DynamicViewDecorations.cs:387-403; Drawing/HeaderInstanceGrouper.cs:37-43; call sites: Selective/SelectiveFrontalBuilder.cs:36,158,169; Selective/SelectivePlantaBuilder.cs:183,203,205; Selective/SelectiveLateralBuilder.cs:201,229,231 + src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawService.cs:44,82,243; Dynamic/DynamicSystemFrontalBuilder.cs:26,171; Dynamic/DynamicSystemPlantaBuilder.cs:74,78-80; Dynamic/DynamicSystemLateralBuilder.cs:257-267; PushBack/PushBackSystemLateralBuilder.cs:181,186,213-227; PushBack/PushBackCompositePlanta.cs:60-62; PushBack/PushBackPlanComposer.cs:134-138; grep of Label(|Annotation|Decoration|Dimension in RackFrames, FlowBed, PushBackCompositeContent.cs, PushBackFlowBedLateralBuilder.cs, DynamicFlowBedLateralBuilder.cs -> no producer

facts.statement: If a library block is missing from the drawing, the drawer records it as missing and creates no entity at all (no placeholder).
Selective creates one named view-definition BTR per inserted view: frontal (one per fondo), planta, and lateral (one per post corte). The rack payload is written on that BTR.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/RackSelectivoCommands.cs:470 (planta), :521 (frontal per fondo), :588 (lateral corte via LateralHeaderDrawService); src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:54,243; Systems/Shared/SystemBlockWriter.cs:33; Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawService.cs:257

facts.statement: Selective also creates nested named header-group BTRs. Frontal: grouper with prefix GroupPrefix, named prefix_Role_n, only for runs of 2 or more identical pieces. Planta: one PLANTA_CAB_n frame group per distinct cabecera frame. Lateral corte: grouper named after the view block.

In the frontal, planta and lateral views, Selective places library-block BlockReferences in the view BTR (loose) or in the nested group BTR. They carry rotation, X/Y mirror scale and dynamic parameters such as LONGITUD and PERALTE.
In the frontal, planta and lateral views, the Selective view BTR holds BlockReferences to its nested group BTRs, one per placement.

Selective places DBText labels (frente number, level number, rack name) in the view BTR on layer RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES, centered and middle-aligned. Frontal: frente, level and name. Planta: frente and name. Lateral: level, post number and name. Each label is conditional on the NumberFronts, NumberLevels or DrawRackName toggle.

Selective places RotatedDimension cotas in the view BTR on layer RACKCAD_COTAS in the frontal, planta and lateral views, gated by the view's effective DimensionDetail (None emits nothing). The dimension uses the user-named DIMSTYLE when present; otherwise it uses db.Dimstyle plus per-entity DIMVAR overrides, and RecomputeDimensionBlock is called.
Each Selective view insert adds one BlockReference to its view BTR in model space through the jig. A cancelled insert erases the definition.
Dynamic creates one named view BTR per view: frontal (entrada or salida), planta, and lateral (whole, or one per-post corte).

Dynamic creates nested group BTRs. Frontal: grouper with prefixes DIN_FRONTAL_ENTRADA and DIN_FRONTAL_SALIDA. Planta: DIN_PLANTA_CAB_n cabecera groups plus DIN_PLANTA_PIEZA grouper groups. Lateral: one group per distinct cabecera, 'Cama dinamica' bed groups and DIN_LARGUERO_INTERMEDIO groups.
In all three views, Dynamic places library-block BlockReferences with dynamic parameters in the view BTR or in nested group BTRs.
The Dynamic view BTR references its nested group BTRs. Alternate cabeceras are mirrored with scale (-1,1,1) in the lateral and planta views.
Dynamic places DBText labels loose in the view BTR. Frontal: frente, level and name. Planta: frente and name. Lateral: level and name. Each is conditional on its toggle.
Dynamic places RotatedDimension cotas loose in the view BTR in the frontal, planta and lateral views, gated by the per-view effective detail. The style name comes from system.DimensionStyle.
Each Dynamic view insert adds one model-space BlockReference to its view BTR through the jig.
Push Back creates one named view BTR per view: frontal (EntradaSalida or Posterior, side A or B), planta, and lateral (whole, or one per-post corte).

Push Back creates nested group BTRs. Frontal: grouper with prefixes PB_FRONTAL_ENTRADA_SALIDA, PB_FRONTAL_POSTERIOR and PB_FRONTAL_INTERMEDIO. Planta: PB_PLANTA_PIEZA. Lateral: the structural cabecera groups inherited from Dynamic, bed groups, intermediate-beam groups and side-B mirrored groups.

In all three views, Push Back places library-block BlockReferences (loose or inside nested groups) and view-BTR BlockReferences to its nested groups. Both are produced by the same drawer code as Dynamic.

Push Back places DBText loose in the view BTR. The labels are the Dynamic decorations it reuses (frontal from the low-cut Dynamic frontal build; planta from the flattened Dynamic planta; lateral from the Dynamic lateral build or, for composite racks, per side). Composite racks add the side labels 'A' and 'B' in the lateral and planta views.

Push Back places RotatedDimension cotas loose in the view BTR through the reused Dynamic decorations, in the frontal, planta and lateral views. In a composite lateral, the structure is drawn without decorations and the cotas are emitted per side; side B is mirrored and keeps its dimension role and style.
Each Push Back view insert adds one model-space BlockReference through the jig.
Cama (flow bed) creates one named view BTR per bed (single lateral view). It has no nested group BTRs because the plan is built with an empty group list.
Cama creates only loose library-block BlockReferences (rail, tope, rollers, brakes) in its view BTR. The rail takes a LONGITUD dynamic parameter.

facts.topic: Cama / flow bed - no DBText or dimension
facts.statement: A standalone Cama creates no DBText and no RotatedDimension: nothing under src/RackCad.Application/Systems/FlowBed produces an Annotation or Dimension instance.
facts.evidence: grep of Label(|Annotation|Decoration|Dimension over src/RackCad.Application/Systems/FlowBed at 3375aadb -> no hit; the only Annotation/Dimension factories are SelectiveAnnotations.cs:23-32, SelectiveDimensions.cs:304-314 and DynamicViewDecorations.cs:387-403

facts.statement: Cabecera (standalone header) creates one named view BTR for the lateral view and one for the planta view. Only the lateral view can create nested group BTRs (through the grouper). The planta plan has an empty group list.
Cabecera creates library-block BlockReferences with dynamic parameters. Lateral: loose, or inside nested groups referenced from the view BTR. Planta: loose only.

A standalone Cabecera creates no DBText and no RotatedDimension: the RackFrames layout builders emit no Annotation or Dimension instance. When a cabecera is the base of a Selective lateral corte, that corte's labels and cotas come from the Selective extras.
facts.evidence: grep of Label(|Annotation|Decoration|Dimension over src/RackCad.Application/RackFrames -> no hit; src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawService.cs:44,197-207; src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Selective/SelectiveLateralBuilder.cs:201,229,231

facts.statement: Each Cabecera view insert adds one model-space BlockReference through the jig.

Cantilever creates one named view BTR per line view (Frontal, Lateral per station, Planta) and redefines it in place by erasing and re-appending its entities. The payload is written on it. The standalone component insertion also creates named BTRs, but writes no payload for them.

Cantilever writes lightweight Polylines (open or closed, one per plan curve with 2 or more points) into its view or component BTR. Each is placed on the layer of its visual role (RACKCAD_CANT_<ROLE>) with colour, linetype and lineweight ByLayer.

Cantilever writes a Circle into the view or component BTR when a plan curve carries CircleDiameter. That happens for a brace rod hole, and for a punch seen down its axis within the foreshortening limit. The views that actually contain circles depend on line geometry and cannot be determined statically.

facts.topic: Cantilever - no BlockReference, DBText or dimension inside the BTR
facts.statement: The Cantilever materializer builds only Circle or Polyline entities. Its BTRs therefore hold no nested BlockReference, no DBText and no dimension, even though an 'Annotation' visual role and layer are declared. Because no dimensions exist, Cantilever produces no *D blocks.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/Cantilever/CantileverViewMaterializer.cs:219-220 (Build returns Circle or Polyline only), 57-59 (comment: nothing nested); src/RackCad.Application/Systems/Cantilever/CantileverVisualRole.cs:53-59,230-231

facts.statement: Cantilever adds model-space BlockReferences in two ways: through the jig for line views (PlaceDefinition), and directly at a picked point, with an X offset per view, for standalone component views (InsertReference).

RACKSECCION creates a named BTR RACKCAD_SECCION_<id>_<view>_L<len> containing only lightweight Polylines. They sit on layer 0 with ByBlock properties, except Axis and Envelope curves, which go on RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES. It also adds one model-space BlockReference. No payload is written.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/StructuralSections/StructuralSectionMaterializer.cs:27,37,55-74,85-87,93-94,101-121,128-134; src/RackCad.Plugin/StructuralSectionCommandFlow.cs:192-196; RackBlockData.Write callers (git grep) do not include these files

facts.statement: RACKLAYOUT adds model-space BlockReferences for each non-seed cell. Each points at the seed's definition (linked) or at an independent cloned BTR. It also adds a model-space DBText label for every cell on layer RACKCAD_LAYOUT (ACI 4).
RACKRELLENAR adds one model-space BlockReference (linked to the seed definition, with rotation) and one model-space DBText label per kept cell, on RACKCAD_LAYOUT.

RACKDUPLICAR and independent RACKLAYOUT copies create a new named BTR per source definition. They fill it with Database.DeepCloneObjects of all of the source definition's entities, so the clone holds whatever entity types that kind has (BlockReference, DBText, RotatedDimension, Polyline, Circle). Nested ARRAY definitions are shared, not duplicated. A DBText equal to the rack name is renamed, the payload is replaced, and a model-space BlockReference is created per selected reference.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/RackCloner.cs:29-67 (34-36 new BTR, 38-50 DeepCloneObjects, 46-47 nested defs shared, 52-63 DBText rename, 66 payload); src/RackCad.Plugin/RackDuplicarCommands.cs:301-319; RackLayoutCommands.cs:243

facts.statement: Before drawing, header-run kinds import any missing library block definitions from blocks-library.dwg using WblockCloneObjects with DuplicateRecordCloning.Ignore. The entity types inside those BTRs are defined by the library, not by RackCad code.

RackCad creates LayerTableRecords only when a layer is absent, and leaves existing layers untouched. Layers: RACKCAD_ANOTACIONES (ACI 2) from the header drawer and RACKSECCION; RACKCAD_COTAS (ACI 1) from the header drawer; RACKCAD_LAYOUT (ACI 4) from RACKLAYOUT and RACKRELLENAR; and every RACKCAD_CANT_* role layer, all created on each Cantilever append.

No TextStyleTableRecord, DimStyleTableRecord, LinetypeTableRecord or RegAppTableRecord is constructed anywhere in src. Dimensions reuse an existing named style or db.Dimstyle; DimStyleTableRecord is only read.
facts.evidence: git grep 'new (…TextStyleTableRecord|DimStyleTableRecord|LinetypeTableRecord|RegAppTableRecord…)' over src/RackCad.Plugin -> no hit; src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:380-392; src/RackCad.Plugin/RackCommandSupport.cs:162 (read only)

facts.statement: On each view-definition BTR (all kinds with a payload), RackCad writes an extension dictionary holding Xrecord 'RACKCAD_SELECTIVE' (the JSON, in 255-character chunks). At drawing level it writes Named Objects Dictionary Xrecords 'RACKCAD_PROJECT' and 'RACKCAD_CUSTOM_PROPERTIES'.
Every top-level entity RackCad creates goes to model space via SymbolUtilityServices.GetBlockModelSpaceId. No code appends to a paper-space layout.

Each RotatedDimension has an anonymous *D block holding its graphics, as the code itself states (DimBlockId, RecomputeDimensionBlock). *D blocks therefore follow only from the kinds and views that emit dimensions: Selective, Dynamic and Push Back, in the frontal, planta and lateral views, when DimensionDetail is not None. Cama, Cabecera, Cantilever, RACKSECCION and RACKLAYOUT produce none. On redefine, the old *D blocks are queued and purged after commit.

The header drawer sets DynamicBlockReferenceProperty.Value on dynamic library references (IsDynamicBlock check) for Selective, Dynamic, Push Back, Cama and Cabecera, then calls RecordGraphicsModified. AutoCAD usually represents a modified dynamic reference with an anonymous *U BTR. The code never names *U, and whether one is created depends on the library block being dynamic and on the values set. This is host behaviour that static reading cannot confirm.
facts.evidence: src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:319,415-448; dynamic-parameter producers listed in F05-S03, F05-D03, F05-P03, F05-C02, F05-H02

facts.statement: On redefine, the drawer collects nestedRef.BlockTableRecord of every old reference as a purge candidate, but registers only blockTable[instance.BlockName] (the named definition) for new references. If a dynamic reference resolves to an anonymous *U record, those *U records would be among the purge candidates. That depends on host API semantics and is not provable statically.

facts.topic: Host-derived blocks under cloning and overrides
facts.statement: Two host behaviours cannot be established from source. First, what DeepCloneObjects in RackCloner does with a cloned RotatedDimension's *D block and with a dynamic reference's *U block (new copies or shared). Second, how per-dimension DIMVAR overrides (Dimscale, Dimtxt, Dimasz, Dimexe, Dimexo, Dimgap, Dimtad, Dimdec) are persisted on the entity (for example as XData).

facts.topic: Anonymous blocks excluded from rack scan
facts.statement: RackBlockFinder skips anonymous BTRs (and layouts and xrefs) when sweeping rack definitions, so host-derived *D and *U records are never treated as rack views.

RackDefinitionCreator.CreateInTransaction (AUTH-15) has no production caller at 3375aadb; it would create the same types through drawer.CreateSystemBlock or the Cantilever materializer. LateralHeaderDrawService.DrawAt, the only caller of BlockPlacement.AppendReference, has no production caller either.
facts.evidence: git grep CreateInTransaction -> only src/RackCad.Plugin/Systems/Shared/RackDefinitionCreator.cs:39,83 and tests/RackCad.Tests/RackDefinitionCreatorGuardTests.cs:92; RackDefinitionCreator.cs:55,98; git grep '\.DrawAt\(' -> no hit; src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing/LateralHeaderDrawService.cs:162-193,182; Drawing/BlockPlacement.cs:79-95

facts.statement: The code never sets a text style on DBText objects (header labels and layout labels), so the style is the drawing default the host applies. Which style that is cannot be determined statically.

limitations: Read-only static analysis at commit 3375aadb. Nothing was built, run, tested or opened in AutoCAD, so host-side results (*D and *U anonymous blocks, clone semantics, DIMVAR override storage, default text style) are either inferred from code comments or marked UNCERTAIN.

The entity content of library blocks imported from blocks-library.dwg (WblockCloneObjects) was not inspected. That is the library census's job, and this list covers only entities that RackCad code itself constructs.

Whether an entity actually appears is data-dependent: DBText depends on the NumberFronts, NumberLevels and DrawRackName toggles; RotatedDimension depends on the effective DimensionDetail per view; nested group BTRs appear only for runs of 2 or more identical pieces; Cantilever circles depend on geometry. No real drawing was sampled.

The claim that DBText and dimensions are never placed inside nested group definitions comes from tracing every Annotation/Dimension factory call site and every HeaderGroup producer found by the searches below. A producer outside those search patterns would not have been seen.

verdicts.correction: Every RotatedDimension has an anonymous *D block, according to the code comment at LateralHeaderDrawer.cs:109-110. RackCad itself constructs dimensions only in Selective, Dynamic and Push Back frontal, planta and lateral views, when the effective DimensionDetail is not None. However, independent RACKLAYOUT copies and RACKDUPLICAR copy a dimensioned definition's RotatedDimensions through DeepCloneObjects, so their cloned BTRs also contain dimensions with *D blocks; whether new *D records are created is host behaviour (see A04). Cama, Cabecera, Cantilever, RACKSECCION and linked RACKLAYOUT/RACKRELLENAR copies create no dimension. On redefine, the old *D blocks are queued for the post-commit best-effort purge. The cancelled-insert cleanup and EraseViewBlocks do NOT enqueue *D blocks.

missed.statement: The two definition-erasing cleanups collect only nested BlockReference targets and never Dimension.DimBlockId: the cancelled-insert cleanup and the phantom-view erase. By contrast, the redefine path does enqueue *D blocks. Whether those *D records are left orphaned is host behaviour.

On every redefine, nested group BTRs are recreated as NEW records with freshly uniquified names; only the view BTR keeps its id and name. The old group BTRs are purged after commit on a best-effort basis through Database.Purge. The three BTR-creating families use three different uniqueness policies: the header drawer appends '_1', '_2'; Cantilever appends '_2', '_3'; RackCloner appends ' (1)', ' (2)'.

There are other writer paths into view definitions besides the per-kind commands. ProjectVariableMutationExecutor redraws Selective lateral, planta and frontal definitions inside one caller-owned transaction through the same LateralHeaderDrawer, so it creates the same entity types. CustomPropertiesExecutor only rewrites the RACKCAD_SELECTIVE payload Xrecord on existing definitions and creates no entity.

Grouper-produced placements are never mirrored. A nested-reference scale of (-1,1,1) therefore comes only from hand-built groups: the Dynamic lateral and planta cabecera groups, and groups passed through PushBackMirror, which keeps the flag. Push Back planta, both single and composite, flattens the Dynamic planta plan and regroups it as PB_PLANTA_PIEZA. As a result, DIN_PLANTA_CAB_n groups do not exist in Push Back planta definitions, and mirrored cabecera pieces there become per-piece MirroredX references.

missed.statement: Several group-name literals were not stated. The Selective frontal grouper prefix is 'SEL_FRONTAL'. Push Back lateral bed groups are named 'Cama push back' plus a suffix, with ' D<depth>' only when there is more than one effective depth. Reflected composite groups get the suffix ' B'. These become sanitized, uniquified nested BTR names.

Library import clones BTRs with WblockCloneObjects from a side database read by ReadDwgFile. Beyond the requested BTRs, the host may also bring in dependent symbol-table records the library blocks reference, such as nested BTRs, layers, linetypes and text styles. RackCad code does not construct these, and static reading cannot confirm which records arrive.
